steps.name: Assert installed MediaHandler.swift is patched at both video sites
steps.run:
FILE=mingla-business/node_modules/expo-image-picker/ios/MediaHandler.swift
if [ ! -f "$FILE" ]; then
  echo "FAIL: $FILE missing after install"
  exit 1
fi
net_count=$(grep -c 'isNetworkAccessAllowed = true' "$FILE" || true)
if [ "$net_count" != "2" ]; then
  echo "FAIL: expected 2 'isNetworkAccessAllowed = true' (one per video writeData site), got $net_count"
  exit 1
fi
opt_count=$(grep -c 'options: resourceOptions' "$FILE" || true)
if [ "$opt_count" != "2" ]; then
  echo "FAIL: expected 2 'options: resourceOptions' (both video writeData sites patched), got $opt_count"
  exit 1
fi
if grep -q 'writeData(for: resource, toFile: destinationUrl, options: nil)' "$FILE"; then
  echo "FAIL: a video writeData site still reads 'options: nil' — iCloud videos will fail PHPhotosErrorDomain 3164"
  exit 1
fi
echo "OK: both video writeData sites set isNetworkAccessAllowed=true (options: resourceOptions); no video site reads options: nil"
